lines.text: An open door stands in heaven, and twenty-four elders in white sit on thrones around the throne.
Four living creatures with six wings and many eyes surround the throne, saying "Holy, Holy, Holy" day and night.
The twenty-four elders cast their crowns before the throne and say God is worthy because He created all things.
A scroll with seven seals appears, and an elder says the Lion of the tribe of Levi has triumphed.
The Lamb stands at the throne's center, takes the scroll from the angel, and the elders fall down before Him.

wrong_details.true: the right hand of the One seated on the throne
